From devices to systems

We investigate security at multiple levels, combining hardware design, cryptography and photonics.

01

Secure SoCs
on RISC-V

Secure architectures and cryptographic primitives for embedded systems, with protection against physical attacks.

→
02

Physical security
primitives

PUFs, TRNGs and hardware mechanisms for unclonable identities, robust randomness and secure key management.

→
03

Integrated photonics
for security

Photonic devices and hybrid approaches to secure identities, communication and cryptographic mechanisms.

→
04

Open die-to-die
communication

Open frameworks and methods for trustworthy communication between chiplets in heterogeneous systems.

About us

Hardware security
at IMSE-CNM (CSIC)

The security of modern computing infrastructure relies on hardware. At HWSec-CSIC we explore advanced, open approaches to secure systems, including RISC-V architectures and integrated photonics.

We are based at the Instituto de Microelectrónica de Sevilla, a joint centre of CSIC and the Universidad de Sevilla.
